scratchScenePrerequisite.requiredAssets: The dedicated RenHReferenceAnimation source materials/textures, source manifest, VideoClip/timeline, pipeline and original artist reference. The captured Tokon manifest enumerates material/map references; these H generated assets are not promoted in this checkpoint.

reproducibilityScope: Frozen exact shader/map inputs, tested controller/builder snapshots, runtime assertions and GPU PNGs are preserved. A new player build additionally requires reconstruction of the separately untracked historical H scene and its original inputs; no standalone checkout rebuild is claimed.
explicitExclusions: All outline source/shell code/evidence (ongoing separate proof)
All generated H/Tokon scenes or prefabs under main Unity
Unreviewed eye derivatives or new production rig claims
stagingManifestSelf: Include this staging-manifest.json and STAGING.md alongside the exact stageOnly list; no staging or commit has been performed by this agent.
hashEncoding: sha256 records frozen working/tested bytes. gitStoredSha256 records Git blobs (LF-normalized text or verified LFS pointers). LFS asset OIDs match sha256 exactly.
